fields.gross_qty: Total absolute quantity across open lots.
fields.long_avg_price: Average entry price of the long leg, or None.
fields.short_avg_price: Average entry price of the short leg, or None.
fields.avg_price: Common entry basis, or None for flat/hedged exposure.
fields.net_notional: Signed net notional at the observation price.
fields.unrealized_pnl_net: Unrealized P/L after remaining entry fees.
fields.entry_fees_remaining: Entry fees allocated to still-open quantity.
fields.return_fraction: Net return as a fraction; None if no common basis exists.
fields.balance: Initial balance plus realized gross P/L minus paid fees.
fields.margin_used: Gross notional multiplied by the margin fraction.
fields.limit: Absolute limit price, or None for no limit.
fields.stop: Absolute stop trigger, or None for no trigger.
fields.valid_bars: Maximum eligible future bars, or None for no bar expiry.
fields.reason: Reason for the recorded decision or termination.
fields.error: Failure text, or None when no error was recorded.
fields.allocation_id: Identifier of this allocation between a fill and a trade.
fields.trade_id: Lot identifier shared by its partial exits.
fields.kind: Whether the fill allocation opens or closes a lot.
fields.fee: Fee charged or allocated to this execution.
fields.entry_fee: Entry fee allocated to this closed portion.
fields.avg_fill_price: Average execution price, or None before a fill.
fields.triggered: Whether the stop trigger has activated.
fields.sequence: Monotonically ordered event position within the run.
fields.timestamp: Market-data index value at the event.
fields.phase: Execution phase that produced the event.
fields.snapshot: Frozen OrderSnapshot containing order_id, status, and reason.
fields.symbol: Asset label; does not fetch market data.
fields.price_tick: Optional price increment; None leaves prices ungridded.
fields.min_notional: Minimum opening notional in settlement currency.
fields.reference_price: Price used to calculate the requested quantity.
fields.estimated_cost: Estimated costs for the calculated quantity.
fields.budget: Notional or risk budget; None for a pure quantity request.
fields.id: Read-only identity of the drawing in this run.
fields.title: Display title of the drawing.
fields.panes: Maximum panes, including the main pane.
fields.events: Maximum color, marker, fill, and account events.
fields.text: Maximum UTF-8 bytes of labels and other text.
fields.alpha: Opacity byte: 0 is transparent and 255 is opaque.
fields.multiplier: Positive integer count of timeframe units.
fields.timeframe: Declared Timeframe of the supplied bars.
fields.timezone: Timezone used to display/group aware timestamps.
fields.is_first: True on the first input bar.
fields.is_last: True on the final input bar.
fields.source: Whether sizing was explicit or supplied by the default.
fields.closed_count: Number of closed fragments, including partial exits.
fields.win_count: Closed fragments with positive net P/L.
fields.loss_count: Closed fragments with negative net P/L.
fields.even_count: Closed fragments with exactly zero net P/L.
fields.winning_profit: Sum of positive closed-fragment net P/L.
fields.losing_amount: Absolute sum of negative closed-fragment net P/L.
fields.average_profit: Mean net P/L per closed fragment, or None without closures.
fields.win_rate: Winning fraction from 0 to 1, or None without closures.
fields.strategy_sha256: SHA256 digest of the executed strategy source.
fields.dependencies_sha256: SHA256 digest identifying its local code dependencies.
fields.experiment_id: Identifier of the experiment in that database.

Range.stop: Inclusive upper bound when it falls exactly on the grid.

Slippage.mode: none, fixed price distance, or bps (basis points).
Slippage.value: Nonnegative slippage amount in the selected mode.

DefaultOrderSize.value: Positive quantity, or an equity fraction in (0, 1].

OrderSizingSnapshot.value: Original size value; percent uses percentage points (20 means 20%).

FillRef.id: Read-only identity of the drawing in this run.
FillRef.title: Display title of the drawing.
